title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — September 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.5 (Peaked September 19, 2026 at 05:36 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: B9.5 (Peaked September 19, 2026 at 01:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 429 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Small solar flicker! 🔥

A broad dark coronal region stands out across the lower-left solar disk, while the surrounding corona appears otherwise quiet.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
